method: Edit Mode isolated Physics3D scene; native CharacterController.Move; instance-only runInEditMode hand callbacks; manual tracking-validity override. No Play Mode, input devices, saved assets, global collision layers or default-scene simulation.
limits: Native character movement and self-collision pair bookkeeping only. Hand sweeps use default Physics queries and remain covered by the separate Play Mode validator; lifecycle steps here use clear remote coordinates and do not establish those sweep results. Not headset locomotion/comfort or a build acceptance result.
